whole_command_resource_scope: includes cargo startup, test setup, warmup, assertions, all native returns and output/journal writes; compilation if any must be disclosed; not per-stage CPU or ordinary-binary performance
maximum_rss_scope: Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum in KiB; not a simultaneous aggregate of all process memory
profile: unchanged workspace test package profiles with all features, locked/offline, one Cargo build job
sample_storage: original overlay filesystem; no tmpfs database substitution
prior_observer_unavailable: GNU /usr/bin/time does not exist; no measurement command was started
